method: Four validator processes and one client on shared 8-logical-CPU macOS AArch64 host. Same release binary, real Ed25519, 128-request / 1 ms durable journal batching, 20 ms fixed one-way delay, 5-second offered load windows, 5-second observation deadline, max-inflight 16384, queue diagnostics off. One faulty validator @v0; remaining three execute unchanged protocol. Honest and silent controls; order reversed for second trial. Throughput includes drain. No warmup exclusion. Recovery is outside timing. Faulty node deliberately bypasses Replica/journal signing rules and retains only initialization; recovered state is compared with its own actual state, not with honest ledger state. This is a bounded scripted attack, not an arbitrary-adversary or DoS guarantee. Shared hardware allows faulty nodes to free CPU/I/O by doing less honest work. Adaptive 1500 TPS flood followup after the 2000 TPS flood showed queueing.

attacks.withhold: Valid operation votes; withhold effects vote on alternating effects requests; ignore final certificates.
attacks.equivocate: Valid operation votes; sign Cancel then Effects for the same context and transaction; send both to the client; ignore final certificates. No peer-to-peer gossip or partition simulation.
attacks.invalid-flood: Eight identical invalid-signature votes per operation/effects request, signed then corrupted; no valid votes. Flood has a fixed request-proportional amplification, not unbounded traffic.
attacks.silent: One validator receives requests but never votes.
attacks.honest: All four validators execute normal durable protocol.

honest-r2000-t1.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and effects QC verification from strict Ed25519-verified immutable votes and quorum/domain/key-binding checks; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
honest-r2000-t1.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

validation.default_tests: 2 unit and 15 integration tests passed serially
validation.clippy: all targets/all features scoped Clippy passed
validation.process_safety: Every honest validator shutdown count and value matched the client finalized count; every journal recovery matched its own shutdown state. Process tests independently verified all emitted effects certificates.
validation.queue_diagnostics_tests: 2 unit and 15 integration tests passed serially; measurements used default diagnostics-off release binary
